name: The Family and the Fishing Pole

meta.wiki: The Family and the Fishing Pole

summary: Gubber Blump and his heirloom Fishing Pole await a catch on Auberdine's docks. Hostile murlocs keep the town's small fishing boats ashore, so Gubber seeks help catching native Darkshore grouper from the coast.

sections.title: A Dwarf Far From Ironforge
sections.body: Gubber Blump takes pride in a family known for its skill with a fishing line. Night elves make up most of Auberdine, though dwarves and gnomes have settled around its docks and port. Gubber spends his days gazing over the Veiled Sea instead of digging into stone, hoping to bring in the local catch.

sections.title: Murloc Infestations and Darkshore Grouper
sections.body: Darkshore grouper thrive along the coast and make versatile food, but they can put up a lively fight on the line. Local fishermen usually row small boats into deeper waters to catch them. Now aggressive murlocs prowl the coast, and small boats no longer go out. Gubber fears the creatures are eating the local fish, so he asks travelers to fish from shore.

sections.title: The Blump Legacy
sections.body: Gubber gives a Blump Family Fishing Pole to anyone who brings him a hearty catch. He believes anyone who can land a batch of feisty groupers is worthy of his family's legendary anglers, including his cousin Graun Blump. For Gubber, handing over a family rod is the highest mark of respect.

faq.answer: Gubber Blump is a dwarf fisherman on the docks of Auberdine in Darkshore. He comes from a proud family of anglers, teaches basic fishing techniques, and gives the family's signature rods to promising fishermen.

faq.q: Why aren't boats going out from Auberdine to fish?
faq.answer: Hostile murlocs prowl large stretches of the Darkshore coast, making it too dangerous to launch small fishing boats. Local anglers stay by the piers and shallows.
A Darkshore grouper is a native saltwater fish found off Darkshore's coast. Anglers prize the lively fight it puts up and its use in hearty coastal recipes.
Graun Blump is Gubber's cousin and, in his telling, has a full beard and a pungent smell. He counts her among the finest anglers their family has produced.

faq.q: Why are there dwarves in a night elf town like Auberdine?
faq.answer: After the Third War and the forging of the Alliance, dwarves and gnomes from Ironforge crossed the sea to Kalimdor. They came to trade, build maritime links, and help their new night elf allies with harbor infrastructure.

faq.q: What is the Blump Family Fishing Pole?
faq.answer: The Blump Family Fishing Pole is a sturdy rod used by the Blump clan. Gubber gives these treasured poles to travelers who prove their angling skill in Darkshore's waters.

angles.text: As a dwarf, finding another of your people devoted to fishing instead of subterranean smithing or brewing reminds you how varied dwarven pursuits can be.
Darkshore grouper is a reliable, nutritious catch along northern Kalimdor's coast and a staple for meals at frontier camps.
As an Alliance member, you find Auberdine's harbor bringing mainland races and night elves together against coastal dangers such as murlocs.
